subject.title: feat: persist catalog feed change history

question: Should ClawHub adopt the RFC 39 catalog delta contract now, including durable revision sequencing, exact cumulative counts, 30-day history retention, and reset-to-snapshot semantics?
rationale: These choices become persistent backend and future public transport contracts while the governing RFC remains open and no maintainer has confirmed the direction in this PR.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded delta contract
options.body: Approve the RFC semantics and continue the stack after the specification and runtime-proof gaps are closed.

options.title: Keep the journal experimental
options.body: Permit further development without merging the durable schema or transport until the contract is finalized.

options.title: Pause the catalog delta stack
options.body: Defer the stacked PRs if snapshot refreshes remain the intended distribution model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded delta contract
recommendation.body: Approve the RFC semantics and continue the stack after the specification and runtime-proof gaps are closed.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level product and durable API-contract decision rather than a mechanical implementation choice.
